text: If you've been waiting for a stretch of easy, low-drama days, this is it. Today's partly sunny with a high near 79, light west wind, and the lake's about as calm as it gets, waves a foot or less and water sitting at a comfortable 73. Humidity's high first thing but it'll ease through the day. Friday looks even better, sunny with a high near 80 and light winds on the lake again, basically a repeat performance. The models are tightly bunched both days, so confidence is good, no hedging needed. The forecasters' own reasoning backs this up too: dry through Friday, with showers not returning until Saturday into Sunday. Air quality's good, so no worries there. Good call for either day: get out early or late for the light, but honestly the whole afternoon's fair game on the water, no real wind or wave concerns to plan around.
